name: Vanguard Seraph
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

needs.what: a `you_gain_life` trigger that fires only on the player's first life-gain event of the turn, counted per player over the whole turn (including gains made before this permanent entered): `LIFE_GAINED` needs a per-player ordinal in `data["nth"]` (as `DRAW` and `SPELL_CAST` carry, folded off the turn ledger) so `nth: 1` can be honoured on `you_gain_life`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `nth` is answered by `triggers._ordinal`, which reads `event.data["nth"]`, and `primitives.gain_life` fires `LIFE_GAINED` with only `amount`, so `nth: 1` would never match. `max_per_turn: 1` is a per-permanent cap on queued firings, so a Seraph entering after you already gained life this turn would wrongly trigger on the next gain (the engine's own comment on `nth` names this exact fault). A `condition` on `life_gained_this_turn` is an intervening-if read after the gain, and the ledger holds a total, not a count of gain events, so it cannot tell the first gain from a later one
